diagnostics.message: null_resource.delete_http_settings does not depend on null_resource.delete_probe. HTTP settings reference the probe, so on destroy the settings must be removed before the probe. delete_http_settings currently lists null_resource.set_probe instead — a create-only resource with no destroy provisioner — so delete_probe has no incoming ordering and can be destroyed in the first wave, deleting the probe while HTTP settings still reference it (referential-integrity failure). It should depend on null_resource.delete_probe.

null_resource.delete_http_listener does not depend on null_resource.delete_frontend_port. HTTP listeners reference the frontend port, so on destroy the listener must be removed before the frontend port. delete_http_listener currently lists null_resource.set_frontend_port instead — a create-only resource with no destroy provisioner — leaving delete_frontend_port with no incoming ordering, so the port may be deleted while a listener still references it. delete_http_listener should depend on null_resource.delete_frontend_port.
